facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Information says the Head of the Civil Service launched on 10 September 2025 a Digital Literacy Action Plan, run with NITDA and Cisco on the National Digital Literacy Framework, that mandates participation by all officers in Core MDAs on a two-month timeline starting with ICT Directors and Digital Literacy Champions; no number trained is given.

systems.platform: Cisco/NITDA course, enrolment by government email
systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
